General office duties are routine admin workflow

Reading claim forms and records to check coverage is document extraction plus a rules check
Damage assessment from photos and site visits is a vision task
Mostly written correspondence to fix errors and omissions
Interviewing witnesses and claimants depends on trust and judgement
Complex severe claims need accountable human judgement
Reserve setting is numeric estimation
Conferring with legal counsel on litigation
Flagging questionable claims is evidence weighing (fraud triage)
Phone and in-person contact with doctors and employers
Written exchanges with reinsurance brokers
Presenting and debating cases in committee
Detecting over and under payments is data analysis
Attending mediations and trials in person
Routing unresolved cases to the right team is workflow triage
Payroll processing is form and record handling
Booking travel is a multi-step tool workflow
Sorting and routing incoming mail is document processing
Representing an executive in meetings
Professional ethics and confidentiality
Resolving meaning across languages and cultures
Localising software and documents
Educating people about the interpreter's role
Training and supervising other translators
Reading source material to render it in another language
Guiding tourists in person
Scoping work and agreeing fees with clients
